text:
maria: Quick check — telemetry owners, can we freeze the token_cost event schema before EOD? Billing team needs a stable shape for their smoke tests.
kevin: I can own the schema freeze. question: do we include both cost_per_token and total_cost?
diane: Product wants per-route breakdown later, but for now total_cost + cost_per_token ok. also we need a latency tag (bucket) so we can correlate cost vs latency.
sam: ML + infra: latency_bucket as enum is fine. also include seq_len (int) so we can filter long-context cases.
maria: tagging @ben for ingestion mapping — will the pipeline accept these new optional fields without backfill?
ben: pipeline accepts optional fields, but we need a mapping PR for downstream materialized views. I'll put up a mapping change.
kevin: opened schema PR: <https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/4523|#4523> — schema diff below:
```json
{
  "event": "token_cost",
  "properties": {
    "request_id": "string (optional)",
    "session_id": "string (optional)",
    "model": "string",
    "seq_len": "int",
    "tokens": "int",
    "cost_per_token": "float",
    "total_cost": "float",
    "latency_ms": "int",
    "latency_bucket": "string" // e.g. "0-50", "50-200", "200+"
  }
}
```
ben: looked quick — LGTM. minor naming nit: prefer "latency_bucket" values to be consistent with existing histograms. will update mapping accordingly.
diane: timeline: Billing smoke test targeted Tue 2026-03-24 09:00 PST. can we canary Mon 2026-03-23 22:00 PST?
maria: that works for core team. we should also decide join key for attribution: request_id or session_id?
sam: session_id helps aggregate user-level costs, request_id helps dedupe across retries. I'd vote both optional, primary join = request_id for attribution algorithm.
kevin: will add both, mark request_id as primary attribution_key in schema doc.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-03-23T22:00:00Z for ingestion mapping change. Canary window: 2 hours.
ben: thanks infra-bot. I'll post the mapping PR and canary runbook later today.
maria: final action items: Kevin — merge schema PR + update schema docs; Ben — mapping PR + canary; Sam — validate latency_bucket labels against ML telemetry; Diane — own billing smoke test coord. Ping here when PR merged.
kevin: ack, will merge after 1 more review.
ben: mapping PR coming in ~3h.
maria: perfect. if anything blocks, drop a short note here and @everyone if urgent :thumbsup:
